summary: Session correcting dao1.earth vs day1.build conflation, defining dao1.earth as governance/voting blockchain application + DAO holdings company, then brainstorming complete technical architecture for build with 3-dimensional participation model, no-wallet UX, and support for DAOs/LLCs/stock/real assets.
keyDecisions: No third-party wallets - server-managed keypairs with KMS encryption
3D participation model: Public/Private ownership × Direct/Federated voting × Treasury/Governance
Hybrid architecture: blockchain for immutability, DB for performance
Support multiple entity types: DAO, LLC, public stock, asset trusts
Tech stack: React/TypeScript, Node/Express, PostgreSQL, Polygon blockchain
